name: dashboard
description: Scripting OpenWrt（Nikki/OpenClash/MihomoTProxy）管理面板：前台系统采样与 CPU 信息切换卡、代理模式与节点测速、规则及连接；Nikki 配置/订阅/附加规则编辑、服务与核心操作，含路由器详情预取、主题与安全日志。功能取决于插件版本与设备权限。

localizedDescriptions.zh: Scripting OpenWrt（Nikki/OpenClash/MihomoTProxy）管理面板：前台系统采样与 CPU 信息切换卡、代理模式与节点测速、规则及连接；Nikki 配置/订阅/附加规则编辑、服务与核心操作，含路由器详情预取、主题与安全日志。功能取决于插件版本与设备权限。
localizedDescriptions.en: Scripting dashboard for OpenWrt (Nikki/OpenClash/MihomoTProxy): foreground metrics and in-place CPU/system info card, proxy modes and testing, rules and connections; Nikki profile/subscription/rule editors, service and core operations, router-detail prefetch, themes and safe event logs. Features depend on plugin versions and device permissions.
